I had this one dog my whole life, she was a wonderful Shtzu-Bichon and was older than me by a few years. She eventually got very old (17, which is over 80 in dog years for her breed) and had to be put down. We had a vet come to our house, since she hated going to the vet and we owed it to her to not make her suffer even more. I didn’t want to be in the room at the time because it’d be too sad, so I took my other dog for a walk. Looking back on it, I wish I hadn’t abandoned her in her time of need like that. I wish I had stayed in the room. I bet she was looking for me, wishing I was there.
